$description: Deprecated Monarch APIs. `deprecations`: { name, package, since, replacement?, message? } for an export that is deprecated; `monarch check` reports usages as api/deprecated in files that import from the package. `importPaths`: { names, pattern?, from, to, since, removeNoEarlierThan?, message? } for exports that moved to another entry of the same package and stay available from the old one until `removeNoEarlierThan` (a date); `monarch check` and the ESLint rule monarch/no-deprecated-api report an import of one of `names` (or of a name matching `pattern`, which covers their types) from `from` and rewrite it to `to`. Add an entry in the same release that deprecates the API; remove it only when the API is deleted, in a 0.14.N patch released after that date.
